name: FRED MORTGAGE30US (Freddie Mac 30-Year Fixed Mortgage Rate, via FRED API)
measures: Weekly average 30-year fixed-rate mortgage commitment rate (Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey), republished by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.
cost: Free. FRED API key is free and immediate on registration, no trial/paywall. Documented rate limiting exists (third-party sources cite ~120 req/min); FRED's own docs just say 'contact us' if you need more. A weekly series pulled at most daily is nowhere near any plausible limit.
license: Attribution required: FRED's Terms of Use require citing FRED as source, preserving any copyright notices on the underlying data (Freddie Mac PMMS), and not implying FRED/St. Louis Fed endorsement. No commercial-use prohibition surfaced in search, but the exact copyright terms on the MORTGAGE30US series specifically should be confirmed at adapter-build time rather than assumed from the general FRED ToU.
relevant_gap: backend/app/scoring/investment.py hardcodes Assumptions.interest_rate = 0.065 as a static default. This series would let that default track the actual prevailing rate at run time instead of a stale constant, and could backfill a historical rate series to sanity-check rate assumptions used in past backtests.
existing_overlap: None found — grep across backend/app/ turns up no FRED/BLS/FHFA source today; interest_rate is the only rate input and it's a hardcoded float.
recommendation: Strong recommend. This directly fixes a real, visible gap (a hardcoded 6.5% mortgage rate assumption) with a few lines of code: one series, no sub-national geocoding/matching needed, free key, 55 years of history, official government-adjacent data via the Fed. Lowest-effort, clearest-value candidate in this batch.
